thread_text:
Juniper L: Quick sync — propose a slim launch for private: three egress presets (nat-relay, bgp-peer, preserve-ip), an installer preflight validator, and a canary+drain upgrade. Keep console work for phase 2.

Ravi P: Agree. Minimal installer flags: --egress-mode=nat|bgp|preserve --preserve-ip=198.51.100.9/32 --bgp-asn=65025 --canary=0.1 --egress-validate-only. Default nat.

Nora T: Validation must check IP routability, overlapping prefixes, and BGP origin ASN. Add clear error strings: EGRESS_IP_IN_USE, BGP_NOT_ACCEPTED.

Juniper L: Launch gates: docs + runbook, two pilots validated, staging canary with rollback, telemetry for egress validation and upgrade outcome, security signoff if KMS needed.

Ravi P: I'll own installer + test harness (2 sprints). Nora owns netops onboarding template. Juniper owns pilot comms.

infra-bot: Created INFRA-14500: "egress preflight + canary harness" assigned to @Ravi P and @Nora T, due in 10d.
